articles.title: Google Unveils New Android AI Protections to Block Scam Calls, Phishing Links and OTP Theft
articles.summary:
Google has announced a new set of Android security protections designed to stop mobile scams across calls, text messages, chat apps, web links, and account verification codes. The update comes as criminals increasingly use spoofed phone numbers, fake bank alerts, phishing pages, remote screen sharing, and AI-generated voices to trick users into giving up money […]

The post Google Unveils New Android AI Protections to Block Scam Calls, Phishing Links and OTP Theft appeared first on Cyber Security News.
